title: Directional and interval-exchange reductions for polygonal billiards
exact_target: For polygonal billiards, classify the ergodic invariant probability measures and the closed invariant subsets of the billiard flow. In a rational polygon, the invariant components associated with fixed directions are part of this classification problem.
